name: Fixture 6: progressive failure
note: Issue W2-01. A redundant two-member frame: members 1 and 3 run from the two surface supports to the free joint node 4 and are mirror images, so they have equal length, stiffness, and mass and carry equal moments while both stand. Their sections differ only in yield strength, so member 1 reaches utilization 1 first. Once it is removed, member 3 holds the load alone as a cantilever.
description: Positions are room units (Y up) and go through the scale adapter at scaleFactor. The load is bridge-world newtons, applied suddenly on the first step and held for stepCount steps of dt seconds (one step at 60 Hz) with the default damping ratio. Section values are fixture-local, not game constants: the yield strengths are chosen so member 1 fails within the first half period while member 3 stays below utilization 1 after carrying the whole load.
